name: Sliver Weftwinder
description: An apex sliver that can burrow beyond the tangible and hollow the Weft, living within the Chaos Wall.

timeline.summary: The Weftwinder emerges and makes its home within the Chaos Wall.
timeline.quote: Able to burrow beyond the tangible, to hollow the Weft as one might bore tunnels through earth, the Weftwinder has found its home within the Chaos Wall.
